title: Clove-Gilly-Glower
summary: CLOVE-GILLY-GLOWER, noun A species of Dianthus, bearing a beautiful flower, cultivated in gardens; called also Carnation pink. Note: Some writers suppose that gilly-flower should be written July-flowe

inlines.v: CLOVE-GILLY-GLOWER, noun A species of Dianthus, bearing a beautiful flower, cultivated in gardens; called also Carnation pink. Note: Some writers suppose that gilly-flower should be written July-flower. [See clove.]
